SQL_STMT_U.val: SELECT s.id, s.sales_date, s.billing_date, s.customer_id, s.sale_specific_customer_name, s.billing_customer_id, s.standard_sales_amount, s.standard_return_amount, s.standard_discount_amount, s.standard_tax, s.reduced_sales_amount, s.reduced_return_amount, s.reduced_discount_amount, s.reduced_tax, s.remark, i.billing_start_date, ( SELECT sd.transaction_specific_product_name FROM sale_detail AS sd WHERE sd.sale_id = s.id ORDER BY sd.id LIMIT 1 ) AS first_product_name FROM sale AS s INNER JOIN invoice AS i ON i.bill_to_customer_id = s.billing_customer_id AND i.billing_end_date = ':3' INNER JOIN closing_calculation AS cc ON cc.customer_id = s.billing_customer_id WHERE (:1 = 0 OR s.billing_customer_id = :1) AND cc.closing_day = :2 AND s.sales_date BETWEEN i.billing_start_date AND ':3';
